Section 8.1 Termination.

This Agreement may be terminated at any time prior to the Effective Time:

(f) by Parent, if there shall have been a breach of any representation, warranty, covenant or agreement on the part of the Company set forth in this Agreement, which is not cured within the earlier of (1) the Outside Date and (2) 30 days following written notice to Parent;

(g) by the Company, if there shall have been a breach by Parent of any covenant or agreement on the part of Parent set forth in this Agreement, and such breach shall not have been cured within 30 days after written notice thereof;

(h) by Parent, if the Company shall have breached any of its representations, warranties, covenants or other agreements contained in this Agreement, and Parent has delivered to the Company written notice of such breach, delivered at least 45 days prior to such termination (or such shorter period of time remaining prior to the Outside Date).
